examples.text: A tokenizer maps text into token identifiers.
UTF-8 encodes Unicode text as bytes.
A vocabulary defines valid token identifiers.
A sequence has a maximum context length.
Truncation removes tokens beyond the context limit.
Packing combines examples within a context window.
Deduplication happens before train validation test splitting.
A dataset card records provenance and usage rights.
A split manifest stores stable identifiers and hashes.
Validation data guides model selection without final test leakage.
The private test split stays isolated until evaluation.
A seed makes split assignment reproducible.
